channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Many Cinco Ranch MUD residents must update payment information as billing system changes
item.description: Cinco Ranch municipal utility district residents should watch for instructions on their water bills this month about updating payment information as the districts transition to a new billing software system and online customer portal.

item.title: Alamo Drafthouse Cinema in Katy closes, ending Houston-area presence after 22 years
item.description: Alamo Drafthouse Cinema closed its La Centerra location in Katy on Saturday, ending the theater chain's presence in the Greater Houston area after more than two decades.

item.title: County Clerk Candidate Tamara McFarlane: Lawsuits, Campaign Turmoil, and Questions About Being a Real Republican
item.description: Fort Bend County Clerk candidate Tamara McFarlane is being sued by a Dallas roofing company for nearly $11,000, the latest of a series of controversies as key people are walking away from her campaign.

item.title: Houston Methodist West Cardiologists: Heart Disease Prevention Starts With Simple Lifestyle Changes
item.description: Heart disease kills someone in the United States every 40 seconds, but Houston Methodist cardiologists say most of those deaths are preventable.

item.title: Katy ISD FFA Livestock Show and Rodeo Continues Through Feb. 14
item.description: The annual Katy ISD FFA Livestock Show and Katy Rodeo continues through Feb. 14, bringing agricultural competition and Western entertainment to the L.D. Robinson Pavilion and Billy Morgan Rodeo Arena, 24263 Beckendorff Road.

item.title: Katy ISD Dedicates Boudny Elementary, Honoring Educators' 75 Years of Service
item.description: Katy ISD dedicated its newest elementary school Monday night, honoring educators Alfred and Ann Boudny before hundreds of community members, district officials and elected officials.

item.title: Alamo Drafthouse to be Replaced by Flix Brewhouse
item.description: Flix Brewhouse is acquiring four Texas dine-in cinema locations formerly operated by Triple Tap Ventures as an Alamo Drafthouse franchisee, including the LaCenterra location in Cinco Ranch.

item.title: Texas regulators agree to review Katy's rejection of battery storage facility
item.description: he Texas Public Utility Commission is expected to take up the case of Ochoa Energy Storage's application to build a 500-megawatt Battery Energy Storage System facility in Katy

item.title: Taylor takes oath as City Council now has three women – a first for Katy
item.description: Paula Taylor took the oath of office Monday in a historic first: Katy City Council now has three women members for the first time ever.

item.title: Katy Council advances plan to save iconic Cardiff Rice Dryer and other historic structures
item.description: The Katy City Council voted Monday to create a historic preservation committee that could save the city's iconic 177-foot Rice Dryer and other landmarks threatened by modern building codes that can make redevelopment very difficult.
